chapter: Los Angeles: Roy Milton and Central Avenue
title: Gerald Wilson's band and Central Avenue after-hours
summary: Gerald Wilson's band with Melba Liston at Shepp's and the after-hours places on Central.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: had Jimmy Bunn playing piano and writing for the band, and Hobart Dotson, one of fine trumpet players, and Tucker Green was playing drums, and... He had a fine band. Melba Liston was with the band. She was writing and playing her trombone with the band. That's where I first met all of that gang, you know. It was really, really nice.

And Eddie Heywood downstairs... Just activity. It was full of activity. On Central Avenue, they had several after-hour places also. Around 29th they had the Jungle Room. And the thing was Jack's Basket Room.
